content.text: A wildlife survey counts herons at 4 ponds over 6 days with detection rates 0.6, 0.7, 0.8 and 0.9 by pond. Daily raw counts at pond A: 3,5,4,6,2,5; B: 7,6,8,5,7,6; C: 2,3,2,4,3,3; D: 9,8,10,9,8,9. Estimate the true mean population per pond, compare the ponds, check whether any pond shows a trend, and plan a better survey. Think it through carefully.
